sample.topic: Should Animals Be Used For Scientific Research?
sample.argument: Animals suffer tremendously and there are other means to test cosmetics, drugs, and the like. Animals aren't always the best catalysts for results. Animals cost money to feed, maintain by paying vet bills, house. Animals testing is cruel and antiquated as a testing method. Why not use humans instead and see how humans like pain, disfigurement, and suffering.

sample.topic: Are Social Media Making People Stupid?
sample.argument: Yes, Social media is absolutely making people more stupid on the whole. People have learned not to think for themselves. They have learned to get all information on life from the internet and from watching videos, seeing articles on social media etc and assuming that the information they are being presented is true. They don't take the time to fact check themselves or the information that is being given to them and therefore begin to adopt beliefs that are not true and do not actually represent accurate depictions of certain events.
sample.rebuttal: If we were to actually gather data, I don't think it would support the argument that social media has made people smarter. I think we would find out that people all too frequently are taking things they see on social media as the truth and therefore they are being fed misinformation from multiple different angles. People become so engrossed in what they are doing that they are unlikely to be taking the time to actually research what they are being told and find out if the information is truly accurate. They take "influencers" for example and assume that because they have some level of popularity that they must know what they are talking about and are telling people the truth. They themselves start to spread this information to others and wind up making the masses less intelligent on the whole than they were before.
sample.conclusion: I stand by my position that misinformation is being spread rampantly, whether intentionally or just purely through ignorance. Too often people just don't know any better and will spread things they see via social media to others on the assumption that because their friend/family member saw it and posted it, that it must be true. We need people to think for themselves and take the time to go through the information they are being fed and actually did into what is true. Social media is often not the real world and doesn't always give an accurate depiction of what the real world is actually like or what is actually going on. News and information spread easier because of social media, but if what is being spread isn't accurate or useful, you would have a hard time convincing me that people are suddenly smarter because of something they saw from a 12 year old on Tik Tok
sample.argumentOpponent: Social media is not making people more stupid, but allows them to research topics and actually become smarter as they can interact better with those around them. Reasoning to show an example of this is how people who have not taken a traditional college or schooling route are able to make a lot of money without ever entering the working world. The idea of the influencer might seem somewhat disingenuous or vanity filled on the surface, but at the same time, it is a growing profession that can absolutely pay off as we have seen with many people. Social media is something that has taken giant steps and leaps to grow, and it will only do so because of its popularity and ability to focus on intellectual and sophisticated interaction, which then allows people to develop entrepreneurial skills. Therefore, the proof that social media is making people stupid is quite the opposite. It's making them smarter.
sample.rebuttalOpponent: Social media aids in the formal conversation and discussion of varying ideas and topics. Diversity of thought is seen abundantly across social media platforms and because of this, people are learning from one another and are crafting in creating new ideas, innovations, and ways of pursuing wealth and happiness. This could only be done by a group of people who have the ability and the smarts to go against social norms and expectations. In this case, social media has made people smarter because they are willing to challenge the typical ways of communicating and job searching and stand by the millions of dollars they have made as they continue to do so.
sample.conclusionOpponent: In my closing argument, I would certainly like to stress the fact that while what we see on social media might appear alien or abnormal, it is certainly worth noting that it now has become trendy and is taking over as a whole because the lifestyle and glamour that it provides is not out of reach any longer. The walls and odds might be stacked against someone who did not go to school or who does not have wealthy parental figures. With the invention of social media, everyone not only has an equal chance at life and accomplishing their natural talents, but those high walls are now taken down as the playing field is now level and even. Social media is now becoming reality whereas before it was only a small reflection of it.

sample.topic: Should the US Provide Military Aid to Ukraine in its Conflict With Russia?
sample.argument: The US should provide military aid to Ukraine against Russia for a number of reasons.  The first reason is a moral argument.  Russia is the aggressor country and is killing and raping innocent people.  They are targeting infrastructure and grain silos to try to freeze and starve Ukraine to death.  The US also was a signatory to the Buddhapist Accords which says that the US will agree to help Ukraine in it's defense for Ukraine giving up it's nuclear weapons.\n\nThe US has stockpiled tons of weapons during the Cold War in order to defeat Russia should there be a conflict between the two countries.  These weapons are close to being decomissioned which costs a lot of money.  It costs us less money to send these to Ukraine.
sample.rebuttal: Russia is trying to run out the clock so that people lose patience with Ukraine.  If Russia controls Ukraine, the US is going to have much more serious issues to worry about in addition to the one's at home.  For example, Putin will next move into Maldova.  Then it will be on to the Baltics and then to Poland.  The Baltics and Poland are both part of NATO, which will get us in a direct war.\n\nAppeasement never works with dictators.  We tried this with Hitler during WW2 to give him Czechlovakia and he just kept going.  We tried this with Putin in 2014 with Crimea and the Donbass.  Dictators keep going so stop them now before it costs us more in the long run.
sample.conclusion: American's should not fund dictator countries.  America should try to fund the opposition.  That way dictators all over the world will not be emboldened to invade or commit human rights abuses.  Putin's biggest fear is that he will end up like Gadaffi - dead in a ditch, which is how all dictators should end up.  All of our foreign policy problems are due to dictators - China, Russia, North Korea, Venezuela, the Middle East, Cuba.
sample.argumentOpponent: The war has already taken too long and too much of the US's money. The US has plenty of other issues that need dire attention at home first before spreading itself thin in Ukraine. Russia does not seem to be letting go and this war can end up costing America too much.
sample.rebuttalOpponent: If America acted on morals, it would have to save the whole world. Most countries in the world are being lead by dictators, for example, most countries in Africa and Asia. Should America fund them too?
sample.conclusionOpponent: America has done all it can to help Ukraine thus far. The most it can do now is try and bring the countries together for an agreement instead of throwing more money at the war. There are many countries in worse situations than Ukraine, will the US throw money at them too? Many people are working hard to pay taxes in America and they probably would like to see their monies go to better use.
